integrity: An all-length valuation-based proof is provided. Independent finite regression tests exercise all bases 3..7 and lengths 1..149; regression checks are not substitutes for a general proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-end digit Cantor fixed points at integer bases b>=4 and ordinary contiguous palindromes are classified. Neither arbitrary deleted-digit constructions nor occurrence counts are addressed. A previously unindexed equivalent result cannot be excluded.
title: Palindromic-factor complexity of generalized two-end Cantor words
